profile_count.note: Catalogue rows that differ only in production length (18/21/24 m etc.) share one cross-section and are exposed as designations of one size.

geometry_notes: Origin at mid-soffit, y up. K units: 780 wide, x from -390 (rectangular block face) to +390 (ledge edge); block 480 wide.

All R=50 corners are circular arcs tangent to both faces (32 segments). Tangent points are taken from the printed chains; sharp-corner levels are derived (lower splay: 170/330 above soffit for edge tangent 140; PM: 85/245 for edge 55).

Upper flange: sharp outer-edge corner at the printed 75 below top (right-hand chain), fillet tangent on the web at 167 below top (1200 - 673 - 360); the web-root sharp corner follows from R50 tangency (about 124.7 below top). This reproduces the printed 33/49/36/49 and 42/216/42 extents within 0.5 mm.

Top roughening (zdrsnenie povrchu) modelled as a flat top. Edge rebates (30x20 on 2010 I; 40x20 on 2016-I and 2010-R2) are included. 2016-T raised strip 140x20 is included (needed: without it A -0.8 %, yt -6 mm, I -4 %).
Soffit chamfers 15/15 included on all girders; none drawn on 2016-PM units.
Excluded: optional PE-pipe lightening voids (možné vyľahčenie, R50), PE rúra Ø50 duct, DET. A transverse holes, prestressing, ducts, end blocks (2.1 m end section 'na čele nosníka').

2010 I 1.4 m: pp. 18 and 19 embed the same drawing image (PDF image object 312). Its bottom chain prints 300/100/300 = 800 and left splay 26/249/26; the upper 200 web label, 800 total and the right-hand 247 fix web 200 and splay 247. Properties match exactly with web 200.

2010-R2 1.9 m: left chain 33+49+36+49 = 167 but right chain labelled 168 (82+85) and 168 + 1372 + 360 = 1900. Convention: the flange edge is 34 (not 33), i.e. sharp edge corner 76 below top and web tangent 168; slope and R50 extents unchanged. Evidence: with 168 A/yt/I residuals are -0.004 % / +0.2 mm / -0.03 %; keeping 167 (web 1373) gives -0.11 % / -0.8 mm / -0.25 %.
2016-I right chain prints 33 + 135; 49+36+49 = 134 and the depth closes with 167 (167+673+360 = 1200). 167 used.

2010-R2 2.1 m: the literal drawing (re-read at native 218 ppi, 5x zoom, and cross-checked against the separately drawn centre-of-beam prestressing view, which scales 1100 wide, 200 web, 73-75 edge, 183 root) is closed and self-consistent, but the published yt 1.016 m and Iy 0.39284 m4 are not reproduced: literal outline gives A -0.13 %, yt 985.8 mm (-30.2 mm) and I -4.8 %. No single plausible misreading (flange edge, root depth, web width) fits all three; a 3-parameter fit needs a 137 mm flange edge and 186 mm web, contradicted by the drawing. Implemented as drawn; discrepancy pinned as a source inconsistency.
2016-PM13-M: A 209000 mm2 vs printed 0.208 m2 (+0.48 %, beyond 3-s.f. rounding); yt and I agree (+1.0 mm, +0.3 %). Unresolved; pinned.
2016-PM units: I is systematically +0.27 to +0.39 % above published for both K and M (A and yt agree to rounding). Unresolved (possible producer tessellation or rounding convention); pinned per size.
2016-T and 2016-I: A is 395 mm2 (-0.08 to -0.11 %) below the 5-s.f. published areas; the same deficit on both 2016 designs. Unresolved; within stated tolerance.

The earlier assessment note that PM M units were ~3 mm high in centroid came from placing the splay/stem junction at the '170 from top' dimension line; that dimension goes to the upper splay tangent line (400-170 = 230 = 55+44+132 ~ 231). With the 55/44/132/44 chain the M centroids agree within 1 mm.

resolved_issues.resolution: Artefact of the assessment's reading: 170 dimension goes to the upper splay tangent line, not the stem/splay corner. With 55 + 44 + 132 + 44 chain and R50 tangency, M-unit yt residuals are +0.5 to +1.0 mm.

pp18 and 19 embed the same image (PDF object 312), so both pages carry the slips. Web 200 (upper 200 label, 300+200+300 = 800) and splay 247 (right side) used; A/yt/I match to -0.03 %/-0.1 mm/-0.05 %.

Not resolved. Drawing re-read at native resolution and checked against the independent centre-of-beam prestressing view; outline is self-consistent. Implemented as drawn; pinned: A -0.129 %, yt -30.17 mm, I -4.804 %.
